place: Around Misurab village, Shaho mountains, Kamyaran
impact: Oak woodland in the protected Shaho area caught fire (see ecocide record).
summary: KHRN reported that IRGC forces deployed artillery around Misurab village and shelled parts of the Shaho mountains on 31 October and again on 1 November 2026, and set up checkpoints on roads to nearby villages. The IRGC made no statement.

place: Oak woodland around Misurab, Shaho protected area, Kamyaran
summary: KHRN and Rudaw reported that IRGC artillery shelling of the Shaho mountains on 31 October 2026 set fire to vegetation and oak woodland in the area protected since 2009.

place: Komala base, Alana (Dola Alane) valley, Balîsan (Balisan), Xelîfan (Khalifan), Hewlêr (Erbil)
summary: Shafaq News, Rudaw and Hawar News reported that two drones struck a Komala base in the Alana valley of Balisan on the morning of 4 November 2026, causing material damage and no casualties. Komala blamed the IRGC; the IRGC made no claim.

impact: A family home was heavily damaged.
summary: Rudaw reported that an airstrike hit the house of Alwan Abdullah in Tewêle shortly after 1 am on 4 November 2026, heavily damaging it while the family was away. Rudaw grouped it with Iranian drone attacks that night, but its security source did not name the attacker.
